biography.value: The Endless Dark is the Shadow Plane's full predatory nature distilled into a single entity. It is old enough to understand precisely what summoners need from it and will follow clear instructions without requiring them to be simplified.

system.sensesNotes: Darkvision unlimited, Devil's Sight, See Invisibility, Perfect Sight 120 ft
system.attacksNotes:
Void Rend [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 6 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 15 damage (9 + 6 Str) + 5 Negative damage (Ignore DR); target loses 6 from Current Luck; max HP reduced by 16 until long rest.
  • Margin 2: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 Negative damage; Current Luck reduced by 8; max HP reduced by 24; Weakened + Sickened + Disoriented + Dazed for 1 minute; no save.
  • Margin 3: 15 damage, DR halved (round up) + 5 Negative damage; all conditions; max HP reduced by 32; target makes Fortitude [Hard] save or loses 2 points of Constitution permanently until Major Restoration; target also loses 1 point of Wisdom permanently until Major Restoration.

Shadow Annihilation [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 5 + Ranged Combat 6), Range: 200 ft, 20-foot diameter.

  • Margin 1:: 20 Negative damage (15 + 5 Dex); Current Luck reduced by 5; max HP reduced by 12.
  • Margin 2: 20 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); Current Luck reduced by 8; max HP reduced by 20; Weakened + Sickened; no save.
  • Margin 3: 20 Negative damage, DR halved (round up); all conditions; max HP reduced by 28; Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Shadow Form: In dim light or darkness, immune to all non-magical damage and non-Positive energy damage. In bright light, DR 6 applies normally. Life Drain Aura: Creatures within 30 feet that are not Shadow creatures lose 6 from their maximum HP at the start of each of their turns. This maximum HP loss persists until long rest. A creature reduced to 0 maximum HP by this aura dies. World Darkness (1/day) [Combat]: As 2 [Combat] actions, the Endless Dark extends its nature across a 120-foot diameter. All light sources within the area (magical and mundane) are suppressed for 1 hour. Positive energy weaves of cost 8 or higher can suppress the darkness within their area while active. The Endless Dark and all Shadow creatures see through the darkness. Shadow Army (1/day): As a [Combat] action, the Shadow Lord calls 4 Shade Walkers and 2 Dark Stalkers from the Shadow Plane. They appear in unoccupied spaces within 30 feet and act on the Endless Dark's initiative, following its direction. They are not under the summoner's control. Duration: 1 hour or until dismissed. Planar Step (at-will): The Endless Dark steps between shadows freely, teleporting up to 60 feet to any dim or dark location it can see as a [Move] action. Consuming Darkness: When a creature dies within 60 feet of the Endless Dark, the Endless Dark regains HP equal to that creature's Constitution score × 4. This triggers regardless of what killed the creature. Cold Immunity Sharing: The summoner and up to 4 designated allies gain immunity to cold damage while within 60 feet. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Endless Dark fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
